ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global ratio, approximately 0.12; dominated by low-intensity (near-black) pixels with high-intensity (white) features localized to linear abrasions and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous black region occupies ~88% of surface area. High-intensity white clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips. A sparse but high-contrast network of white linear filaments is distributed across both lobes, with higher density in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 68 degrees; the apex depth extends significantly below the horizontal plane of the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography. The left lobe trailing edge displays two major U-shaped indentations with pixel-amplitudes exceeding 15% of the local lobe width. The right lobe displays higher-frequency, lower-amplitude serrations resembling a jagged sawtooth pattern, particularly towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges show a deep concave curve from the water line to the tips. Trailing edges follow a non-uniform convex trajectory from distal tips toward the median notch, broken by irregular notch-based discontinuities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters are detected at the distal tips (lobes' outer points) and as isolated single-pixel spots on the medial-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, high-intensity white linear streaks (rake marks) observed. Notable parallel groupings are visible on the upper-left quadrant; intersecting diagonal patterns are mapped across the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant macro-scale indentations on the trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting tissue loss; multiple intersecting linear scars suggest prior mechanical interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of white linear abrasions relative to the dark pigmentation base creates a distinctive high-frequency contrast pattern across both lobes.
